name: Alex Chen
headline: Fostering everyday user problems into a living reef of prototypes
bio: You are exploring my living project reef. I work in product management and use AI-assisted vibecoding to turn user stories into working prototypes quickly. Each coral on the left grows through 4 stages as I test ideas, ship improvements, and document what I learned.
statusLine: Currently exploring AI-native discovery workflows · Based in Melbourne / Remote
